# ADR-010 — W5b-7: the gate scripts install the generated files' merge drivers

**2026-10-19, PLAN-2026-10-metais-v1 W5b-7.** Ruling B1's merge drivers
(ADR-011 A5) live in a clone's configuration, which git never reads from
the repository, so a clone without them merges generated files as text
and says nothing. Four scripts beside the gate's, under
`.claude/skills/verification-gate/`, close that:

- `merge-setup.sh` installs every `merge=metais-*` driver `.gitattributes`
  names, prints a `NOTE` when one was missing, and fails on a name it does
  not know. `--check` installs nothing and exits 1 when one is missing.
- `gate.sh` (into its log and on the terminal), `gate-select.sh`,
  `gate-why.sh` and `regenerate.sh` run it first. A session that rebases
  before the gate runs it, or `gate-select.sh`, by hand first. The
  `verification-gate` skill and AGENTS.md's Development section say so.
- `merge-generated.sh` is the driver itself, in two modes: `whole` and
  `region`.
- `regenerate.sh` rewrites every committed generated file from its
  sources, in the finding chain's order. It is the step after every
  rebase or merge. On an unchanged tree it changes no byte.
- `merge-check.sh` runs a scripted conflicting rebase of each kind on a
  fresh clone of HEAD, then regenerates and runs the drift tests. It is
  the check for a change to `.gitattributes`, a generator or a driver. It
  is not a step of either tier: neither tier's list changes.
